title: Cover remaining fingerprint refusal diagnostic phases and independent metadata guards
outcome: Add focused deterministic coverage for the remaining fingerprint diagnostic branches without adding production test hooks unnecessarily or weakening refusal behavior.
acceptance: Targeted tests exercise open, final-lstat and symlink/readlink diagnostics and document platform-specific omissions, with deterministic metadata-field guards where feasible.
Existing mutation rejection and success fingerprint contracts remain intact, and the final change carries required independent review and full-gate evidence.
